unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager scope vs supplied universe
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The repository snapshot marks Wafra as an unknown manager (knownManager=false; canonicalManager=null) and prohibits proposing a new manager or funds, while the supplied manager universe separately lists Wafra. This creates a scope contradiction preventing inclusion of any vehicles despite evidence that Wafra operates real assets and infrastructure strategies.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Confirm whether Wafra should be added to the version-controlled manager universe with a canonical identity; if approved, re-run the census allowing fund-level inclusion.
